newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers rise on futures, weather.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers rise on futures, weather.

text.p: European bunker prices firmed on Thursday as futures prices rose due to freezing weather, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst fob prices rose $2-$3 to $119/120 a tonne on a scarcity of product. "It's difficult to obtain product and of course the cold weather has helped prices to rise," a dealer said.
"There was no demand during the holiday period but now everybody is back. There has been a lot of activity today," said an Antwerp dealer.
Ice in Hamburg pushed 180 cst to around $132/134. "There will be an ice surcharge on top...Ships will be needing tug assistance," said one dealer, expecting a further rise in prices.
In the Med, gas oil was $1-2 up with cold weather in Genoa. "It's not as cold as in northern Europe but prices are still up," one dealer said.
But in Cape Town prices were little changed, with 180 cst at around $119-121, MDO at $240-242 and gas oil remaining at $250-252.
